conditions.source_exact_text: | `DAC-NFR-001` | inventory、graph、findingは同一HEADと同一registry入力に対して決定的である。 |
preserved_conditions: HARNESS-L2-010 requires same input and version to reproduce the same pack artifact.
HARNESS-L2-011 pins capability/contract/dependency versions and correlates progress, result, and evidence.
HELIXOS-L2-015 records source identity/revision/digest, decision provenance, and correction history; its L11 tests source traceability and authority projection separation.
unconfirmed_residuals: No fixed L2/L11 oracle specifically repeats DAC inventory, graph, and finding generation for identical HEAD plus registry input and compares outputs.
General pack artifact reproducibility and authority record traceability do not establish deterministic DAC scanner output.

conditions.source_exact_text: | `DAC-NFR-004` | GitHub、network、providerが無くてもrepo-local censusを再現できる。外部surfaceは別adapterで追加する。 |
preserved_conditions: HARNESS-L2-011 avoids binding calls to a specific GUI, local path, provider, or CI product.
HARNESS-L2-010 requires declared dependencies, and HELIXOS-L2-015 separates authoritative records from Issue/PR projections.
unconfirmed_residuals: No fixed L2/L11 condition requires repo-local census reproduction with GitHub, network, and providers absent.
No fixed L2/L11 condition establishes that external surfaces are added through a separate adapter boundary.
Environment-independent invocation does not itself establish offline repo-local input sufficiency.

conditions.source_exact_text: | `DAC-NFR-005` | scannerは文書本文を書き換えず、削除せず、findingと修復候補だけを出力する。 |
preserved_conditions: HARNESS-L2-003 routes meaning-changing differences to Backflow instead of silently rewriting upstream meaning.
HARNESS-L2-004 and its L11 conditions identify impact/revalidation gaps and prevent false no-loss claims when source atoms are missing, duplicated, digest-mismatched, or orphaned.
HELIXOS-L2-015 prevents management records and projections from generating requirement meaning or human decisions and retains original events.
unconfirmed_residuals: No fixed L2/L11 clause expressly prohibits the scanner from editing or deleting document body content.
No fixed L2/L11 clause restricts scanner output to findings and repair candidates or tests that output boundary.
Authority non-generation and original-event preservation do not prove corpus non-mutation.
